releaseNotes: new: The updates window now opens with every release highlight fully readable — the window sizes itself to the notes, even when they arrive after the window opens
new: Release categories rendered as soft tinted cards with slim side accents and one refined filled tag per category — the old outlined oval badge is gone
new: Version chip in the highlights header and a quiet fade-in entrance when the notes load
fix: Window height fitting now accounts for the title bar settling after open, so notes are never cut off at the bottom edge
fix: Resizing the window width no longer disturbs the fitted height
